releaseNotes: v244 keeps invoice numbers visible and assigned in both Draft and Issued states. Draft-to-Issued conversion retains the same number; invoice numbers are reserved only after a successful save. Issued payment status remains independently selectable as Paid or Unpaid. Removes the redundant Cancel button and shows only the latest release note in Software Update.

v243 separates invoice status from payment status in the invoice editor. New invoices default to Draft; selecting Issued defaults payment to Paid, with editable payment date (today by default) and Bank Transfer (Cash selectable). Paid saves create or update the linked Accounting income record; Unpaid saves remove the linked invoice income record. No existing invoices are changed until edited and saved.

v242 assigns the saved invoice status after all invoice editor fields and calculations are populated, and adds the actual form field value to the read-only diagnostic. It also fixes diagnostic line breaks. No existing invoice records are changed.

v241 fixes the invoice edit status contradiction: setInvoiceDraftMode now only controls invoice-number visibility and no longer overwrites the Status field loaded from the saved invoice. The read-only v240 diagnostics remain available. No existing invoice records are changed.

v240 adds a read-only invoice edit diagnostic comparing the selected invoice ID and status in memory with the same record in LocalStorage, including duplicate-ID counts. It does not change or save invoice records.
Pinned v239 release to the slash-free release239 reference to avoid branch-path ambiguity in Safari raw-file requests.
Pinned v239 update manifest and release assets to the dedicated release/v239 reference so the v238 updater reads a consistent, fixed release instead of the moving main branch.
Corrected v239 release package SHA-256 values for all four required app files so the updater can verify and stage the release.
Invoice status diagnostic: invoice list displays a normalized status and the exact saved status value so Draft-versus-Issued discrepancies can be identified without changing existing invoice records.
Isolated experimental copy of v226 for the separate accountancy-test repository.
Accounting, project, contract, factory-reset recovery, and language localStorage keys use the tha_test226_ namespace.
IndexedDB database and Service Worker CacheStorage names use separate test-only namespaces.
Update channel and release downloads point only to this test repository.
Production repository, production data keys, and Final_backup.json were not modified.
All remaining invoice sequence, diagnostics, report archive, help-draft, and language preference keys were moved into the tha_test226_ namespace.

Removed the hard-coded minimum invoice number; numbering now starts at 1 when no prior invoice/income number or reserved sequence exists, and otherwise continues from the highest saved or reserved number plus one.
Corrected numbering: the next number is one greater than the highest existing invoice/income number or reserved sequence; an empty installation starts at 1.
Invoice number previews no longer reserve or consume a number when the New Invoice form is opened or cancelled; a number is reserved only after a successful save.
One-time migration removes uncommitted sequence increments from earlier test builds, using the highest persisted invoice or income number as the baseline.
Factory Reset now clears the invoice sequence so a genuinely fresh local installation starts at invoice number 1.
One-time test-only cleanup removes only the exact £1 income record numbered 143 with reference ISOLATION TEST; other records are not matched or deleted.

v229 adds a one-time test-only migration: if there are no saved invoices or income records, reset stale preview/reservation sequence values to zero so the next invoice starts at 1; if saved records exist, preserve the higher reserved sequence and all records.
Unifies Accounting Records so independent income, expenses, and customer invoices appear in one searchable list.
Adds a read-only View action for invoices from Records.
Invoice deletion is now a soft delete: deleted invoices remain visible in Records with a subdued DELETED status and their invoice numbers stay reserved.
Deleted invoices are excluded from the active Invoices list and cannot be edited or have payment status changed.
The shared invoice/income numbering logic from v229 is retained.
Version 231: a newly installed Service Worker no longer activates automatically during app startup.
A waiting Service Worker is activated only after the user presses Update Now.
Earlier release notes from v228, v229 and v230 are retained in the update information.
Version 232 fixes the update failure: version-manager.js now uses the same namespaced active-cache and pending-activation keys as service-worker.js.

Version 233 adds a non-destructive IndexedDB key-value foundation with verified get, set, remove, key listing, snapshot, migration and comparison APIs. Application records remain on LocalStorage pending staged integration.
Version 234 adds a safe IndexedDB self-test for write, read, key listing and delete. It uses a temporary test key and confirms legacy LocalStorage data is not changed.
Version 235 adds a Monitor & Diagnostics control to run the temporary IndexedDB self-test in the browser. It does not migrate or alter existing app records.

Version 236 fixes a Safari update stall by making Service Worker approval messaging non-blocking after the verified CacheStorage pointer is activated. The app reload no longer waits for Service Worker registration lookup.
Version 237 fixes the IndexedDB self-test button by exposing its handler explicitly on window, showing immediate test feedback, and restoring the button after completion.

Version 238 fixes a literal escaped newline after the IndexedDB self-test handler that caused a JavaScript parse error and prevented the Monitor diagnostics script block from executing. Existing LocalStorage records and IndexedDB migration state are unchanged.
